about: Datasets for the 4D page. base is the one place the index's home is named: when a group moves to its own repository, change base, or give that entry its own base. A #base= hash key overrides it for a session. iso_step spaces the contour lines (iso mode); a layer that clears below its range also gets a line at the low end, the ice edge. form cog reads one COG per time step (listed by the dataset's STAC items) at the overview nearest width cells wide; stamp start says each time stamp opens its period (monthly composites); scale log10 spaces the palette over the logs of the range. form cog with a url (not a path) is one COG with no time axis, shown on every date: a topography (relief lifts its mesh by its values, at the page's relief exaggeration) or, for a file of three bands, an image in its own colours; clip_lat clears cells north of that latitude. level on a surface layer of a dataset with depth picks the level it draws: a number, or shell to follow the Shell level slider (a volume dataset drawn over its whole grid at one depth, with the ocean box still showing its sections).

relay.about: Hosts that send no CORS header, read through a relay when template is set (or a #relay= hash key gives one): {url} in the template is the original URL, {encoded} the URL encoded as a query value, and with neither the URL is appended. The relay must pass Range headers. Reads are still counted under the original host.

datasets.title: ACCESS-ESM1.6 historical ocean temperature (monthly)
datasets.note: conservative temperature, stored in kelvin and drawn in degrees C (offset is added after unpacking); 1850 to 2021, 50 levels, the nominal 1 degree MOM grid. Placed by its nominal xt_ocean and yt_ocean, which are true longitude and latitude south of about 65 N; the tripolar cap north of that is drawn out of place (the store has no geolon_t or geolat_t). Chunks are read from the model's netCDF files on Pawsey (bucket ct-esm1-6)

datasets.title: ACCESS-ESM1.6 ocean temperature, one level over the whole globe
datasets.note: the same store as access-esm-temp, drawn as a surface over the whole grid at the Shell level (the slider under the ocean box), so the box keeps its sections; one level is 4 chunks a month (about 3 MB, the chunks hold 25 levels each)
